title.narrative: Financial Access for Sustainable and Transformational (FAST) Growth Project

description.narrative: The project will use the short-term maturity performance based allocation (SMP-PBA) IPF instrument to finance alongside the Bank of Tanzania, coordinated activities related to achieving the development objective, namely: (i) Establishment of a commercial credit guarantee corporation providing partial credit guarantee products to MSMEs through financial institutions (FIs); (ii) Development of credit infrastructure and collateral registry; (iii) Strengthening MSME competitiveness support ecosystem; and (iv) Implementation monitoring and reporting. Support to relevant legal and/or regulatory reforms will be included to ensure the interventions are not undermined. Outcomes are expected to include; benefits to women and youth, and increased contribution of financing and MSMEs to green solutions. The project is also expected to generate significant private capital mobilization (PCM).
